g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Steps and shortcuts to recover a Windows window that
disappeared off-screen
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-23
First, try the monitor movement
shortcuts
Microsoft’s official shortcut list identifies
Windows key + Shift + Left Arrow and Windows key
+ Shift + Right Arrow as commands that move the…
Activate the window with the taskbar
and Alt + Tab
Even if the window is not visible, you can click
the app icon on the taskbar or select the open
window with Alt + Tab.
Use the Move command in the window
menu
With the active window selected, press Alt +
Spacebar to open the window menu.
Moving from the taskbar icon is
community guidance
A Microsoft Q&A community answer suggests
holding Shift, right-clicking the app icon on
the taskbar, selecting Move, and then using the…
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
